_comment: One catalogue for Earth and target sides. Same id, same unit on both sides. 'pending' features have no Earth layer yet: they always evaluate to Unknown, never to a pass.

features.label: Regional slope
features.tip: How steep the land is on average, in degrees. 0° is flat. Measured across a ~55 km cell, so it describes the landscape, not a single rock face.
features.source: AWS Terrarium DEM (SRTM / NASADEM-derived), gradient of 0.5° mean elevation
features.caveat: No terrain values poleward of 85° (the source DEM tiles stop there).

features.label: Terrain roughness
features.tip: How bumpy the ground is: the typical height wiggle (RMS, in metres) around a flat plane fitted over ~9 km windows.
features.source: AWS Terrarium DEM, RMS residual about a 3×3 least-squares plane at 1/12°
features.caveat: No terrain values poleward of 85° (the source DEM tiles stop there).

features.label: Elevation
features.tip: Height above sea level. Not comparable across worlds; used for access and air pressure.
features.caveat: No terrain values poleward of 85° (the source DEM tiles stop there).

features.label: Day–night surface temperature swing
features.tip: How much the ground surface heats up by day and cools at night, in kelvin. This is the stress behind thermal cycling of seals, batteries and materials.
features.source: MODIS Terra LST long-term day minus night; Antarctica and gaps filled from NASA POWER TS_RANGE (r = 0.92)

features.label: Mean annual temperature
features.tip: The year-round average air temperature near the ground.

features.label: Seasonal temperature range
features.tip: Warmest month minus coldest month, in kelvin.

features.label: Low-sun share
features.tip: Share of daylight hours when the Sun is less than 10° above the horizon. Long, raking shadows like the lunar south pole, where the Sun never climbs above ~2°.
features.source: Computed from latitude and solar geometry (NOAA solar position), whole year

features.label: Longest darkness
features.tip: The longest stretch of continuous darkness in a year, in days. A lunar night lasts ~14.8 days; polar ridges near Shackleton see only a few. Tests battery and heater survival without sun.
features.source: Computed from latitude and solar geometry (10-minute steps over a year)

features.label: Air pressure
features.tip: Standard air pressure at this elevation. Mars is ~0.6 kPa and the Moon has none; Earth's thinnest inhabited air is ~50 kPa.

features.label: Airborne dust
features.tip: Dust in the air near the surface. Raises abrasion and clogging stress on seals, filters and optics.
features.source: NASA MERRA-2 dust surface mass concentration, 2023 monthly mean (via GIBS)

features.label: Precipitation
features.tip: Rain and snow per year. Liquid water binds dust, weathers rock and freezes in cracks: none of that happens on the Moon.

features.label: Vegetation
features.tip: How green the ground is (0 = bare, 1 = dense plants). Plants hide rocks, bind soil and confuse cameras.
features.source: MODIS Terra monthly NDVI 2023, annual maximum (via GIBS)

features.label: Snow or ice cover
features.tip: Months per year the ground is snow- or ice-covered. Snow buries rocks and changes traction.
features.source: MODIS snow/ice cover 2023 via GIBS, months flagged
features.caveat: Antarctic cells without MODIS retrievals are marked unknown rather than 0 months.

features.label: Basaltic bedrock
features.tip: Whether the dominant rock is basalt (1), andesite (0.5) or something else (0). Lunar maria and most of Mars are basaltic; lunar highlands are not.
features.source: GLiM global lithological map v1.0, dominant class per 0.5° cell (Hartmann & Moosdorf 2012)
features.caveat: Cells without GLiM data are written as 0, so a 0 can mean 'no data'. Treat low values with care.

features.label: Distance to settlement
features.tip: Straight-line distance to the nearest mapped town. Higher means more isolated and fewer people, but harder logistics.

features.label: Rock abundance
features.tip: Share of the surface covered by rocks larger than ~0.5 m. Drives wheel and boot hazards.
features.source: Planned: high-resolution imagery rock counts (Earth); Diviner rock abundance (Moon); THEMIS/TES (Mars)

features.label: Soil bearing strength
features.tip: How much load the ground holds before sinking. Controls wheel sinkage and foundations.
features.source: Planned: SoilGrids bulk density + texture proxy (Earth); Apollo/LRO-derived values (Moon)

features.label: Depth to ground ice
features.tip: How deep you must dig to reach ice-cemented ground.
features.source: Planned: Obu et al. permafrost map (Earth); SWIM ice consistency (Mars)

features.label: Salts & perchlorate
features.tip: Soluble salts in the soil, including perchlorate. Water cleanup systems must remove them.
features.source: Planned: EMIT L2B evaporite minerals (Earth); Phoenix/MSL measurements (Mars)
